items.title: Tally integration: automated P&L sync
items.description: A Rust agent pushes month and week period P&L values from Tally into the dashboard automatically, packaged as a Windows Service.
items.reason: Built but not tested or deployed - waiting on authorization before it's tried against a real Tally installation.

items.title: Forgot / reset password emails
items.description: Requesting a reset creates a short-lived token and emails a real reset link via SMTP; completing it validates and consumes the token.
items.reason: Code complete but idle - no SMTP account is configured (SMTP_HOST/PORT/USER/PASS), so reset requests are silently logged instead of emailed.

items.title: Offboarding approval workflow
items.description: Submit -> manager approval/rejection -> finalize, with a real settlement amount and auto-deactivation of the linked login on finalize.

items.title: Manager-approval scoping for leave requests
items.description: Leave requests carry a real employee link, so only a requester's own manager chain (or an unscoped HR/Admin account) can approve or edit one.

items.title: Onboarding stage tracking
items.description: A 5-stage checklist per new hire; completing the final stage activates the employee automatically.

items.title: Inventory expiry/batch tracking + purchase orders
items.description: Items can opt into batch/lot tracking with per-batch expiry dates, and purchase orders can be created and received line-by-line.

items.title: Google Calendar sync for reservations
items.description: Bidirectional push/pull between reservations and Google Calendar, with app-created bookings always taking priority over Calendar-side edits.
items.reason: Code complete but idle. The Calendar API is enabled and the service account authenticates fine, but it currently has access to zero calendars - blocked on a calendar being shared with cep-sync@confetti-exports.iam.gserviceaccount.com (Calendar sharing settings, "Make changes to events" access), after which GOOGLE_CALENDAR_ID can be set.

items.title: Reservations <-> petpooja POS integration
items.description: A live table-status feed from petpooja's POS, replacing the current manual/derived table-free status.
items.reason: Blocked on petpooja granting API access.

items.title: Reservations <-> District integration
items.description: A second third-party reservations/POS integration, similar in shape to petpooja.
items.reason: Blocked on District granting API access; explicitly lower priority than petpooja.

items.title: Inventory QR codes
items.description: QR-code generation/scanning for inventory items.

items.title: HRMS biometric attendance integration
items.description: Pulling attendance/punch data from the client's biometric system into the HR module.
items.reason: Blocked on the client sharing the biometric sheet/system details.

items.title: Org chart visualization
items.description: A visual org chart built from the existing manager-hierarchy data.
items.reason: Blocked on the client sharing the org chart to validate against.

items.title: Factory visibility (CCTV / facial recognition)
items.description: Camera-based production/attendance tracking for the factory floor.
items.reason: Blocked on the client deciding camera counts and plans.

items.title: Riko chat/workflows integration
items.description: Connecting Riko's chat/workflow product into the dashboard.
items.reason: Blocked on Riko replying about API access.

items.title: Rejection & QC
items.description: Rejection percentage by department and batch, defect-reason Pareto, and department-wise defect counts over time.
items.reason: No QC/rejection data exists in any imported source yet, but other sheets that may contain it are currently being reviewed.

items.title: Orders & Dispatch
items.description: Open client order status, delayed SKUs and days overdue, and ready stock available for dispatch, imported from four client order-status workbooks (Rannaghor, Sienna x Buco, Sienna x Dubai, Sienna x WOV).

items.title: Surface the remaining Daily Report sheets
items.description: The Daily Report workbook has two more sheets beyond Kiln Firing, Glaze Application, and Green Production (the three already feeding Daily Production, Items Produced, and Kiln & Energy) that aren't ingested or shown anywhere yet.
items.reason: The two sheets are still being reviewed - what they contain, and which existing view (or a new one) they best fit, isn't decided yet.

items.title: Fiscal-year selectors across dashboard pages
items.description: Store, F&B, Cash Flow, Crafts and Overview pages each get a fiscal-year chiclet selector in place of a fixed year, including a self-upgrading selector on Overview; the old static FY in the sidebar was removed.

items.title: Cafe P&L at weekly granularity, with event sales
items.description: The pre-split Cafe P&L moved from monthly to weekly granularity, whole-cafe weekly event sales were added to the Events page, the Cafe parser's Total-column reconciliation was extended to match, and e2e fidelity tests cover the new granularity.

items.title: FY26-27 targets vs. projection, with multi-year revenue history
items.description: FY Target Plan as an import kind, a Target vs Projection view and multi-year revenue comparison on Store and F&B, a combined Store + F&B targets tab on Overview, and FY-total figures promoted to KPI cards.

items.title: F&B P&L imports: weekly and monthly
items.description: F&B Weekly P&L import with venue/item drill-down on /fnb, and Monthly F&B P&L as a second import kind.

items.title: In-app Excel importer
items.description: Upload a workbook, preview its validation results, and commit the import transactionally, without a manual database step.

items.title: Google Sheets sync
items.description: Connect a Google Sheet from a Drive picker or a pasted URL; saved sources re-sync automatically into review batches.

items.title: Import review and batch management
items.description: Sync modes (auto-commit, manual review, paused), a sync-mode selector with batch filters/pagination/hiding discarded batches, flagging unlabeled hand-typed values as errors, and a full change-details modal per batch.

items.title: Role-based access control
items.description: Roles and granular permissions gate every page, including the Operations pages; a standalone Roles page was later merged into Users and Permissions, and role rank was inverted so the lowest number wins a conflict.

items.title: User invites and account management
items.description: Invite-based account creation, a user-management UI to deactivate/live-revoke/edit roles and permissions, invited users merged into the Users page, and a CLI to create, list, and reset accounts now that open registration is disabled.

items.title: Settings page and configurable LLM provider
items.description: A read-only settings page backed by a settings table, and an OpenRouter LLM provider option with configurable MAX_TOKENS for AI Queries.

items.title: Dark theme and navigation redesign
items.description: Dark theme, a user menu, and a restructured header/sidebar navigation.

items.title: Employee self-service portal
items.description: Employees log in to see their own department roster and generate their salary slips and ID cards.

items.title: Manager-scoped employee management and real department structure
items.description: Department heads manage only their own division's employees, division-scoped and later re-based on the real department taxonomy in place of the earlier 4-value division field.

items.title: Applicant-to-employee hire flow and payslip detail
items.description: Convert a job applicant directly into an employee record, and view full payslip detail per employee.

items.title: HR document slots
items.description: Aadhar, PAN, Offer Letter, and internal document upload slots on the employee record.

items.title: HR Mastersheet import and headcount tools
items.description: The HR Mastersheet as an Excel-import kind, with filtering and sorting on the Headcount tab.

items.title: Department-scoped inventory management
items.description: Inventory items and stock scoped per department.

items.title: Reservation management for the Cafe and Restaurant
items.description: Table and seat reservations for the Cafe and Restaurant - the foundation the guest register and table-merging work below builds on.

items.title: Guest register, editable bookings, and table merging
items.description: A guest register (open by default), editable bookings, and table merging with per-table merge targets and a free-merge flag, refined for clarity and to keep the day view in sync after seating.

items.title: Operations dashboard: production, kiln & energy, and labour
items.description: Daily production, kiln & energy, and labour efficiency views built on newly imported production-log and shift-roster data, each scoped to a fiscal year.
